SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct r.return_line_id) ids, count(distinct r.sales_line_id) sl, sum(r.quantity_returned) qty, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date), sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) datemismatch, sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, count(*) lines, sum(r.quantity_returned) qty, sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan, sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned>f.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty, min(f.sale_date) min_sale, max(f.sale_date) max_sale, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date>r.return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sale_after_return, sum(CASE WHEN f.product_key<>r.product_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prodmismatch, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1
